reevaluated_round9_hold.previous_rationale: README describes a phase-0 planning/toolkit scaffold, not a substantive Xbox port/decompilation project yet.
reevaluated_round9_hold.current_decision: add two distinct game target rows: Monster Hunter and Monster Hunter G.
reevaluated_round9_hold.reason: The current maintainer playing/build guide documents Linux x86, Windows x86, and nxdk Original Xbox build targets; reports the full single-player game playable; and says the Xbox build was tested on one console and in xemu. The Oct. 8 PC test release is real current output but explicitly untested on real Windows hardware. The repository README still carries the old phase-0 wording, so both the superseding guide and stale contradiction are cited. The evidence now passes the substantive implementation threshold.
